The US economy grew 3.4%. So why doesn't it feel like it?
Real GDP grew at a 3.4% annual rate in Q3 2026, up from 2.2% in Q2 (BEA advance estimate, Oct 29, 2026).
Consumer spending grew at a 3.8% pace, and AI investment helped too.
But in a separate report, the Fed's favorite inflation gauge was up 3.6% in September from a year earlier.
This is the first of three estimates.
Sources: BEA, CNBC, AP.
News and education, not financial advice.
